title: 皐月賞の後に・忠犬大激走！

text_block_list.text: It was a fierce bout with Meisho Doto running desperately. But in the end, she finished victorious.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Unbelievable! To think I would be outshone when the stage was undoubtedly mine!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: You cunning assassin! You robber of crowns! Prithee, what be thy name?!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: So that is what you go by? King Ah-um-ah!
Meisho Doto is clearly flustered by T.M. Opera O's theatrics.
The littlest praise frazzles her brain. I might need to watch my words…
Like last time, Meisho Doto is taken away by an ambulance. Thankfully, there's no serious ailment to speak of. These kinds of high-octane races really do a number on her body.
